The two involution quotient maps identify the actual E4 and F summands of proper homology, rather than merely matching isogeny classes abstractly.

The retained complete counts give ordinary quadratic fields Q(i) and Q(sqrt(-33)); their unequal ordinary valuations exclude a root-of-unity Frobenius ratio, so the fields persist through all residue-degree powers. A common CM field cannot embed in both. After a finite defining extension, the connected derived monodromy is literally {1} times SL2 on V_F: its CM-torus projection is trivial and the non-CM projection is onto SL2.

The rank-zero compact-type genus-two model is either smooth genus two or two elliptic components. The actual degree-two elliptic map extends and its positive-component degrees sum to two. In the smooth and (1,1) cases the actual involution and Deuring-Shafarevich force the claimed common cusp specialization. In the (2,0) case the main component map is radicial and the tail involution has exactly its attaching fixed point. If the node maps to O, a selected cusp on the tail has a path to a ramification cusp avoiding B_E, with strictly positive distance; the inserted marked rational tree is retained.

In the (2,0) case the special pushforward is an isogeny on B_E and zero on B_F. Its polarization adjoint identifies the actual global E and Prym homology with those local blocks. This avoids any use of arbitrary global endomorphisms on an unrelated local factor.

checks.finding: Read A41’s complete triangular bimodule basis and comparison. Taking its E-component basis and the free product with T and every V_F letter gives the required first E-core decomposition. B=k<T,V_F,Omega_E> is a free tensor Hopf subalgebra and is D-stable, because Omega_F is already in the retained F algebra. No F-handle is silently replaced by its determinant.

For a fixed first E-core tail, the only part raising initial-slot weight is K=D_B+R_WE. Later-tail terms cannot remove or cross the first core. In K the top Omega_E-count part is multiplication, on each fixed other-letter word, by a polynomial whose coefficients telescope to r_E. This is nonzero for every packet coefficient, so the maximum Omega_E count proves K injective. The maximum weighted initial-slot degree then proves the all-weight kernel inclusion. Weight, not ordinary length, handles the retained weight-one F letters correctly.

The actual fixed subgroup’s graded unipotent closure is stable under G_L and killed by the derived monodromy. All surviving tensors in B fixed by SL2_F have an even number of F letters and scalar determinant^(r/2) action; the other letters are Tate. Thus odd weights vanish and weight 2m has chi^m. The reread A38 criterion applies to the closure of existing pro-ell elements; no rational fixed element is assumed to lift. Original pro-two packets are separately covered by A22, and normalizers by A59.
